question.text: The largest interval lying in $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)$ for which the function $\left[f(x)=4^{-x^2}+\cos ^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}-1\right)+\log (\cos x)\right]$ is defined, is

solution.text:
$f(x)$ is defined if $-1 \leq \frac{x}{2}-1 \leq 1$ and $\cos x>0$ 
or $0 \leq x \leq 4$ and $-\frac{\pi}{2} < x < \frac{\pi}{2}$
$\therefore \mathrm{x} \in\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \text {. }$
